items.title: PlanRefs on the ActionPlan and the working_refs library
items.action: Copy the planned test file docs/plans/2025/tests/tests/lib/test_working_refs.py to tests/lib/test_working_refs.py first. (1) plan_models.py: add a closed `PlanRefs` model (`todo_ids: List[str]`, `issues: List[int]`, each default empty) and `refs: Optional[PlanRefs] = None` on ActionPlan after `base_branch`. Not Mutable; plan_dict dumps with exclude_unset, so a plan without refs (every frozen plan) keeps its digest. Regenerate the schema with `python tools/gen_plan_schema.py`. (2) New plugins/harness/lib/harness_lib/working_refs.py: OVERRIDES_REL = 'working-refs/overrides.json', LINE_REL = 'working-refs/line.txt', STORE_VERSION = 1, DETACHED = '(detached)'; WorkingRefsError(ValueError); parse_refs(tokens) splits each token on commas and whitespace, reads '#N' or all digits as an issue int, else todo_sync.ids.canonical, else raises; duplicates dropped, first order kept. fill_issues(refs, catalog) returns refs unchanged when it names an issue, else the union of the named ids' catalog gh_issues in id order. read_overrides(path) -> Dict[str, PlanRefs] ({} for an absent file; WorkingRefsError for a file that is not a version-1 object). set_override(path, branch, refs) writes {version, branches: {branch: {todo_ids, issues, set_at (UTC ISO, Z)}}} through a sibling temp file and os.replace (add_note.py write_notes pattern); clear_override(path, branch) -> bool. format_refs(refs) -> 'todo-k69m (301)', ids joined ', ' then issues in parentheses joined ', '; issues alone as '#301, #315'. Each function under 50 lines, Optional/Union only.

items.title: plan.py new --refs
items.action: Copy the planned test file docs/plans/2025/tests/tests/scripts/test_plan_new_refs.py to tests/scripts/test_plan_new_refs.py first. plan.py: `new` gains `--refs` (help: comma- or space-separated TODO ids and issue numbers, e.g. 'todo-k69m,#301'). cmd_new parses it with working_refs.parse_refs, fills issues with fill_issues from the TODO catalog when `active().todo.catalog` is set and the file reads (an absent or unreadable catalog leaves the refs as named), and passes them to skeleton, which writes `refs` only when given. A WorkingRefsError becomes a pd.PlanError, so the refusal prints `problem:` and exits 1. Update the module docstring's `new` section (plan.py:21-27) and the write-plan SKILL.md step 1 line with `--refs`.

items.title: /harness:working, the per-branch override
items.action: Copy the planned test file docs/plans/2025/tests/tests/skills/test_working_script.py to tests/skills/test_working_script.py first. New skill plugins/harness/skills/working/: SKILL.md (frontmatter name `working`, argument-hint '<todo-id|#issue>... | --clear | --list'; the add-bookmark SKILL.md shape: the first word picks set, clear or list; the reply is the script output verbatim) and commands/working.py (add_note.py's shape: sys.path lib insert, argparse with --repo and subcommands set TOKENS..., clear, list; main returns 0 or 1 and prints 'working: <reason>' to stderr). The store is cfg.path(cfg.state_dir) / OVERRIDES_REL. The branch is `git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD`; 'HEAD' (detached) keys as DETACHED. `set` fills issues from the TODO catalog as plan.py new does and prints '<branch>: <format_refs>'; `clear` prints 'cleared <branch>' or 'no override for <branch>'; `list` prints one '<branch>: <format_refs>' line per branch or 'no overrides'. Add the skill to the README skill tables and the harness CHANGELOG-style lists the README keeps.

items.title: working-refs mod: scaffold and pure modules
items.action: Copy the planned test file docs/plans/2025/tests/tests/mods/test_working_refs_contract.py to tests/mods/test_working_refs_contract.py first. New mod plugins/working-refs/ (the band-line layout): .claude-plugin/plugin.json (name working-refs, version 0.1.0, dependencies ['git-status'], types ./types/index.d.ts), .claude-plugin/icon.png (copy band-line's; tests/contract/test_plugin_icons.py), .gitignore (.claude-plugin/types/), tsconfig.json, hooks/hooks.json ({modules: ['./register.ts']}). Pure modules, no `$`: hooks/mirror.ts exports OVERRIDES_PATH, LINE_PATH, STORE_VERSION, DETACHED_KEY, DEFAULT_STATE_DIR, DEFAULT_PLANS, PLAN_SUFFIX, PIP_HTML_SUFFIX as `export const NAME = '...'` literals (the contract test reads them; notes.ts and todo-watch config.ts patterns); hooks/config.ts reads state_dir and artifacts.plans from a harness.json text over the mirror defaults (todo-watch readConfig pattern); hooks/plans.ts parses an ActionPlan text into {id, branch, baseBranch, baseCommit, refs, page} (page = the sibling PIP_HTML_SUFFIX file; a plan whose documentation is not that page is skipped, spec Builder's calls) and qualifies(plan, branch, mergeBaseOf, archivedIds): branch match, or baseCommit equal to the merge base of its baseBranch, and no archived id (D2, D3); hooks/overrides.ts parses overrides.json (version check, branches map; malformed reads as none); hooks/line.ts builds {plans, todoIds, issues} for a branch (the override's refs replace the union of the qualifying plans' refs; plan links are never overridden) and renders it: plain text 'plan 2025 · todo-k69m (301)' or 'plans 2024, 2025 · ...' and the ccstatusline form with each plan number an OSC 8 link to the page's file:/// URL (D8); empty when nothing qualifies and no override is set. types/index.d.ts declares the state atom `working-refs.line` ({branch, plans: [{id, page}], todoIds, issues} | null). Unit tests beside each module (*.test.ts, band-line test conventions).

items.title: working-refs mod: hooks, scans and the line file
items.action: plugins/working-refs/hooks/register.ts and hooks/watch.ts. Resolve the project root and harness.json as todo-watch watch.ts does (session cwd, then CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR). The branch comes from git-status's `git` atom. A scan lists the plans folder, reads every *_ActionPlan.json that has a sibling page, runs `git merge-base HEAD <base_branch>` once per distinct base branch and `git for-each-ref --format=%(refname:short) refs/tags/archive/plan/` once (archived ids from the tag names), applies qualifies, reads overrides.json, builds the line and stores it in the `line` atom only when it changed. Triggers: session.start; a branch change in git-status's snapshot; prompt.submit runs `git rev-parse HEAD` and the tag listing and rescans when HEAD or the archived set moved (spec Builder's calls: rebases); a newer mtime of the plans folder or of overrides.json (todo-watch checks.ts mtimeOf pattern) after a Write, Edit or Bash tool call and on prompt.submit. Every git call through $.process.run with a timeout, never throwing (git-status status.ts:155 pattern). After each change write the ccstatusline form to <state_dir>/working-refs/line.txt ($.fs.write; an empty file when nothing shows), per checkout (cfg.path, never main_worktree). README.md (hooks table, state, files, Checks, Loading). Register the mod: .claude-plugin/marketplace.json entry after band-line; CLAUDE.md 'nine TypeScript mods' naming `working-refs` (S1); the root README mod tables and install lines. Tests: hooks/watch.test.ts with a world that answers git, fs and state (todo-watch testWorld.ts pattern): a plan on the branch shows; a sibling plan by merge base shows; an archived plan drops on the next prompt; a rebase that moves the merge base rescans; an override replaces the refs; line.txt is written.

items.title: band-line: the working line as a second line
items.action: plugins/band-line/hooks/band.tsx reads the `working-refs` `line` atom (declared locally in band-line's types/index.d.ts, since working-refs is not a dependency) beside gitAtom and, when it holds plans or refs, draws a second <Text color='subtle'> under the banner text with the plain form of the line (line.ts's format copied or reimplemented from the atom fields: 'plan 2025 · todo-k69m (301)'); formatBanner is untouched. Without the mod the atom holds null and nothing extra draws. band.test.tsx: the world answers the working-refs atom; a set atom draws the second line, a null one does not, another band still stays under it. README: the second line and its source. plugin.json 0.1.1 -> 0.2.0.

items.title: setup-statusline: the working-refs widget, project level
items.action: Copy the planned test file docs/plans/2025/tests/tests/skills/test_setup_statusline_contract.py to tests/skills/test_setup_statusline_contract.py first. ccstatusline.defaults.json gains a third line holding one custom-command widget (new uuid id, commandPath `node -e "try{process.stdout.write(require('fs').readFileSync('.claude/state/harness/working-refs/line.txt','utf8'))}catch(e){}"`, preserveColors true, timeout 1000); customCommandCacheTtlSeconds stays 0 (S3). SKILL.md: step 4 gains the widget for an existing project file (opt-in: ask with AskUserQuestion, then add only that line); a new step resolves `state_dir` from `<project>/.claude/harness.json` (default .claude/state/harness) and rewrites the path in commandPath when it differs; the path stays relative so each worktree prints its own checkout's line (ccstatusline spawns the command with shell: true in its own cwd). The widget is only useful with the working-refs mod; say so. README: the widget row in the Defaults table and the opt-in step. plugin.json 0.2.1 -> 0.3.0.

anchors.expect: **Write the defaults** to `<project>/.claude/ccstatusline.json`, only when that file is absent.

decisions.question: How the work splits between the mod, the widget and the harness (spec Approaches).

options.summary: Mod renders the line; the ccstatusline widget only prints a file
Mod stores refs; a Python widget renders
No mod; plan.py writes refs and the widget matches each repaint

decisions.rationale: Developer's choice: no code or plugin path in the widget, one file read per repaint.

decisions.question: When does a plan qualify for the current branch (spec Section 2)?

options.summary: plan.branch equals the branch, or plan.base_commit equals git merge-base HEAD <plan.base_branch>

decisions.rationale: Developer: two ways to qualify; every qualifying plan shows its own link.

decisions.question: When does a plan link leave the banner (spec Section 2)?

options.summary: an archive/<stem>/ tag exists for the plan
the plan has no open items

decisions.rationale: Developer: plan.py archive is the trigger; checked by tag since archive writes no file.

decisions.question: Where the ccstatusline widget lives (spec Section 4).
decisions.rationale: Developer: the plans folder and state_dir are per-project config.

decisions.question: Where the automatic refs come from (spec Section 1).

options.summary: a structured refs field on the ActionPlan, set by plan.py new --refs
issue numbers scraped from item prose

decisions.rationale: Developer: a distinct field; prose names issues a plan only mentions.

decisions.question: Which files hold the override and the rendered line (spec Section 2 names one refs.json).

options.summary: overrides.json written only by the harness command; line.txt written only by the mod

decisions.rationale: Plan-level: one writer per file, so a mod rescan never clobbers an override written between its read and write; the plan matches are recomputed on each scan and need no file.

decisions.question: When a TODO id's catalog issues are filled in (spec Section 1 says when the line is built).

options.summary: at write time, by plan.py new and the working command (Python reads the catalog)
at render time, by the mod reading the catalog

decisions.rationale: Plan-level: the harness already resolves todo.folder and the catalog; the mod then never reads the catalog or copies its config.

decisions.question: How the plan link renders in ccstatusline.

options.summary: an OSC 8 hyperlink, visible text 'plan NNNN', target the page's file:/// URL; widget preserveColors true

decisions.rationale: ccstatusline 2.2.32 keeps escapes when preserveColors is true and draws OSC 8 links itself (renderOsc8Link, its git-pr widget); a live check confirms it on screen (TASK-8).
